classification: preregistered independent policy-study design; not executed tuning; not optimized receiver; not new performance evidence

policy_grid.construction: K_tilde = K_scale * base_k_tilde; Cartesian product in alpha-major, K_scale-minor order

training.bootstrap_use: namespace reserved; training winner intervals are descriptive and not confirmatory

validation.historical_C: optional descriptive only; cannot affect selection

final.historical_C: optional descriptive only; cannot affect selection

seed_derivation.algorithm: numpy.random.SeedSequence(master_seed, spawn_key=(protocol_version_word, partition_code, zero_based_run_index, stream_code)).generate_state(1, dtype=uint64)[0]; initialize numpy.random.PCG64 with derived seed

selection.estimand: minimum pooled raw-count BER over all nine fixed candidates
selection.candidate_eligible_only_if: all 40 candidate outputs and the paired historical B outputs are valid and complete; no completed-only pooling
selection.if_any_candidate_run_fails: mark that candidate ineligible and retain every failure record; do not replace a seed; continue the predeclared remaining jobs if later authorized
selection.if_historical_B_has_any_missing_or_inval: block selection requiring a complete paired B baseline; do not impute or drop the affected run
selection.finite_high_error_trajectory: retain and include if decoder output is valid
selection.nonfinite_or_invalid_decoder_output: failure record; candidate ineligible unless a separately approved missingness policy changes this contract
selection.training_inference: selection-oriented descriptive statistics only; no confirmatory claim

secondary: coefficient trajectory diagnostics after decoding only
validation_rule.failed_or_missing_valid_output: retain failure; block complete paired inference; no zero imputation or completed-only estimate

failure_policy.resume: same planned IDs, original seeds, identical approved config/code fingerprint only

resource_policy.run_order: partition order TRAIN, then separately authorized VALIDATION, then separately authorized FINAL; ascending run index within partition; candidate ID order within sequence
resource_policy.stop_on_resource_budget: stop before next sequence; preserve completed atomic checkpoints and mark partition incomplete
resource_policy.budget: actual wall-clock and memory limits are to be approved before any execution; M7a makes no runtime/RSS claim

scientific_limitations: one fixed effective discrete gamma_b point; no physical HF Eb/N0 calibration
L=1 real channel gain a=0.75 and zero delay
ADR-005 pseudo-likelihood and ADR-013 conditional full Viterbi
ADR-002 edge/phase mapping and ADR-012 observed-IQ remain reconstruction conventions
source questions SCI-02, SCI-03, SCI-METRIC-02 remain open
training minimum is selection-biased and not confirmatory
validation applies only to the single frozen selected policy and fixed profile

authorization_provenance.explicit_user_authorization: explicit user authorization supplied through this Codex M7b instruction
authorization_provenance.partition_scope: TRAIN only; VALIDATION and FINAL not authorized

execution_limits.rss_limit_semantics: periodic process RSS monitoring, not a hard OS process limit

git.status: unavailable: workspace is not a Git worktree
